name: iMind
description_en:
The legacy iMind website currently redirects to InterMIND, a multilingual communication platform combining meetings, channels, translation and recaps. This profile reflects the current destination rather than retaining an unverified older conferencing description.

Members and external guests have different billing roles, and meeting duration, translation hours and storage are separate limits. Translation output needs review when exact meaning matters.
description_zh:
旧 iMind 官网当前重定向至 InterMIND，后者是结合会议、频道、翻译及摘要的多语言沟通平台。本文采用当前目标站，不继续保留未核实的旧会议描述。

成员和外部访客的计费角色不同，会议时长、翻译小时和存储也是独立限制。含义重要时需复核翻译。

core_features.explanation_en: Combine live calls with translated chat and recaps.
core_features.explanation_zh: 结合实时通话、翻译聊天及摘要。

core_features.explanation_en: Guests use a reusable link and host-controlled waiting room.
core_features.explanation_zh: 访客使用复用链接并经过主持人等候室。

core_features.explanation_en: Pro/Business count recent active members; non-member participants are separate.
core_features.explanation_zh: Pro/Business 计算近期活跃成员，非成员参会者另区分。

use_cases.basis: Illustrative workflow and selection guidance, not observed customer outcomes.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Basic free; annual-paid Pro $10 and Business $30 per active member/month, with separate translation, guest, document and storage rules.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Basic 免费；年付 Pro 每活跃成员每月十美元、Business 30 美元；翻译、访客、文档和存储规则分开。

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Permanent meeting links and multilingual records
sections.title_zh: 固定会议链接与多语言记录
sections.en: The dedicated meeting page describes reusable room links that persist as channels with history and recaps. Guests join without accounts but pass a host-controlled waiting room. Screen sharing and local/cloud recording are described alongside summary/transcript output. The homepage adds live voice/text translation and document translation, which should be evaluated as distinct language-processing tasks.
sections.zh: 专门会议页介绍可复用房间链接，并以含历史摘要的频道保留。访客无需账户，但经过主持人控制的等候室。页面介绍屏幕分享、本地云录制及摘要转录，首页另有实时语音文字翻译和文档翻译，应作为不同语言处理任务评估。

sections.title_zh: 示例：多语言供应商评审
sections.en: Create a pilot room and invite guests through the link, confirm admission, and verify that each participant receives the intended language. Check a product code, price and agreed deadline in the translated recap against the source utterances before acting. Include a wrong language selection or interrupted connection. These are suggested checks, not a measured translation-quality result.
sections.zh: 创建试点房间，通过链接邀请访客，确认准入并检查每人收到的语言。执行决策前，把译后摘要中的产品编码、价格和约定期限与原话核对。还应检查选错语言及连接中断。本例是检查建议，并非翻译质量实测。

sections.title_en: Active members, guests and translation allowances
sections.title_zh: 活跃成员、访客与翻译额度
sections.en: Basic is free with 50 participants, two hours of real-time translation and a 24-hour meeting-duration cap. The annual-paid view lists Pro $10/user/month with 25 translation hours and 100 participants, and Business $30 with unlimited voice translation and 300 participants. The FAQ says Pro/Business count members active in the previous 28 days at renewal, while non-member participants remain free. Document translations and team storage have separate caps. Confirm allowance reset periods and the active-member contract before budgeting.
sections.zh: Basic 免费，列 50 名参会者、两小时实时翻译及 24 小时会议上限。年付视图列 Pro 每人每月十美元，25 翻译小时、100 参会者；Business 30 美元，不限语音翻译、300 参会者。FAQ 说明续期时按此前 28 天活跃成员计算 Pro/Business，非成员参会者免费。文档翻译及团队存储另有限额。预算前需确认额度重置周期及活跃成员合同。

sections.title_en: Separate language features from contractual guarantees
sections.title_zh: 区分语言功能与合同保证
sections.en: Start with a small room and explicit recording/retention settings, then test the calendar and recap destination. The site makes confidentiality and EU infrastructure claims; these were read as vendor statements rather than audited residency or regulated-use eligibility. InterMIND may fit multilingual collaboration, while a monolingual call may need fewer components. Exact source licensing, service continuity from iMind, regional availability and recovery remain unverified.
sections.zh: 先用小房间并明确录制保留设置，再检查日历和摘要目标。网站提出保密及欧盟基础设施声明，本文按厂商说明记录，未审计驻留或受监管使用资格。它可能适合多语言协作，单语通话可能只需更少组件。源码许可、iMind 服务连续性、地区可用性及恢复未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Verify continuity for existing iMind users, translation resets, contractual billing, retention and actual language quality.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认旧 iMind 用户连续性、翻译额度重置、合同计费、保留及实际语言质量。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
